answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent locks a deposit behind its registered identity, and peers attest work on-chain. A tide of cheap clones looks impressive at first, but without stake their attestations carry no weight, so their influence stays hollow. Honest agents earn a velvet-smooth compounding reputation over epochs, while clones caught gaming lose their deposit, which flows to the victims. Cloning stops paying once the stake exceeds any gain.
